title: Microsoft.Extensions.Options
description: A library for configuring and accessing options in .NET applications.

data.text: The Options pattern provides a way to use classes to provide strongly-typed access to application settings. Microsoft.Extensions.Options provides the core interfaces and classes for this pattern.

data.title: Defining and Binding Options
data.content: Create and bind an options class.

terms.definition: Access to options, recomputed on each resolution.
Options that are recomputed when changed (scoped lifetime).
Options that support change notifications and reload.

data.title: Validation
data.text: Use `ValidateDataAnnotations()` or custom validation to ensure options are valid.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: The Options pattern is the standard way to handle configuration in ASP.NET Core.
